translations.web: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
translations.bsb: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so through Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
translations.kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
translations.asv: For how many soever be the promises of God, in him is the yea: wherefore also through him is the Amen, unto the glory of God through us.
